saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

censoring_scope.first_passage: first observed saved-frame chord bracket only

development_roles.component_derivatives: all same-parent derivatives remain within this component

supported_scope.mass_ledger: source-role-specific bookkeeping only (native_initial_mk); whole-initial denominator remains task-specific
supported_scope.native_cause_alias_join: native motive/source-visibility join only; physical destination remains unknown
supported_scope.saved_frame_artifact: exact producer label report and saved-frame quality metadata for this anchor

unsupported_transfer_exclusions: same upstream quality split does not establish physical/control/geometry equivalence with another component
source role native_initial_mk cannot transfer mass interpretation to the other source role
native parent, recovery lineage, and saved window cannot transfer across anchors without exact equality evidence
saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

components.component_unit: one exact CURRENT anchor; no cross-anchor merge

Coefficient to calculate minimum time step dtmin=coefdtmin*h/speedsound (default=0.05)

Fixed Dt value. Use 0 to disable (default=disabled)

censoring_scope.first_passage: first observed saved-frame chord bracket only

development_roles.component_derivatives: all same-parent derivatives remain within this component

supported_scope.mass_ledger: source-role-specific bookkeeping only (initial_spatial_region); whole-initial denominator remains task-specific
supported_scope.saved_frame_artifact: exact producer label report and saved-frame quality metadata for this anchor

unsupported_transfer_exclusions: same upstream quality split does not establish physical/control/geometry equivalence with another component
source role initial_spatial_region cannot transfer mass interpretation to the other source role
native parent, recovery lineage, and saved window cannot transfer across anchors without exact equality evidence
saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

components.component_unit: one exact CURRENT anchor; no cross-anchor merge

attributes.comment: Defines domain of simulation (default=Uses minimum and maximum position of the generated particles)

censoring_scope.first_passage: first observed saved-frame chord bracket only

development_roles.component_derivatives: all same-parent derivatives remain within this component

supported_scope.mass_ledger: source-role-specific bookkeeping only (native_initial_mk); whole-initial denominator remains task-specific
supported_scope.native_cause_alias_join: native motive/source-visibility join only; physical destination remains unknown
supported_scope.saved_frame_artifact: exact producer label report and saved-frame quality metadata for this anchor

unsupported_transfer_exclusions: same upstream quality split does not establish physical/control/geometry equivalence with another component
source role native_initial_mk cannot transfer mass interpretation to the other source role
native parent, recovery lineage, and saved window cannot transfer across anchors without exact equality evidence
saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

components.component_unit: one exact CURRENT anchor; no cross-anchor merge

development_roles.component_derivatives: all same-parent derivatives remain within this component

unsupported_transfer_exclusions: same upstream quality split does not establish physical/control/geometry equivalence with another component
source role native_initial_mk cannot transfer mass interpretation to the other source role

saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

censoring_scope.first_passage: first observed saved-frame chord bracket only

development_roles.component_derivatives: all same-parent derivatives remain within this component

supported_scope.mass_ledger: source-role-specific bookkeeping only (native_initial_mk); whole-initial denominator remains task-specific
supported_scope.native_cause_alias_join: native motive/source-visibility join only; physical destination remains unknown
supported_scope.saved_frame_artifact: exact producer label report and saved-frame quality metadata for this anchor

unsupported_transfer_exclusions: same upstream quality split does not establish physical/control/geometry equivalence with another component
source role native_initial_mk cannot transfer mass interpretation to the other source role
native parent, recovery lineage, and saved window cannot transfer across anchors without exact equality evidence
saved-frame chord observations cannot be promoted to continuous first arrival or hidden-event truth
native numerical position/density cause cannot be promoted to physical spill, legal flux, or dynamical error
QN, QE, and QI remain UNKNOWN and receive no credit

components.component_unit: one exact CURRENT anchor; no cross-anchor merge

attributes.comment: Defines domain of simulation (default=Uses minimum and maximum position of the generated particles)

parameters.analytic_target: two finite symmetric quintic cycles active0..8, neutral rest8..12
